name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
title: Netweb Technologies India Ltd - 543945 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 86.6% to INR7,737m with 13–14% EBITDA margin guided, but inventory days jumped 60→86 and management gave no quantified capacity or supply-side detail; base order book only ~INR800-900m ex-strategic orders.

utilisation.quote: Our capacity utilization would be around 65% to 70% only.

capex.quote: There is no capex expansion. No significant capex is expected in this financial year '27.

triggers.label: Inventory days 60 → 86
triggers.quote: Inventory days increased from 60 days in December 2025 to 86 days in March 2026

triggers.label: Order book INR2,100cr + L1 INR327cr
triggers.quote: we already have on our books more than what we had billed for all of last year

triggers.label: Utilisation 65–70%
triggers.quote: Our capacity utilization would be around 65% to 70% only.

guidance.value: 35% to 40% over next couple of years
guidance.quote: we are guiding a growth -- revenue growth of 35% to 40% over the next couple of years

guidance.value: No significant capex; routine INR20-25 crore
guidance.quote: No significant capex is expected in this financial year '27.
we will stay within the range of 90 to 110.

red_flags.quote: Inventory days increased from 60 days in December 2025 to 86 days in March 2026

red_flags.label: Short-term borrowings up despite cash
red_flags.quote: Borrowings are largely to fund the strategic orders.

red_flags.quote: this stake sale was done in the month of February

evasions.quote: I think we will not like to guide on the inventory and the margin.
We would like to stick to the guidance on an overall basis.
I'm not supposed to guide on the component pricing on my call actually.
